data.name: Sax
data.gender_notes: Sax is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘sceaxe’, meaning ‘knife’, ‘sword’. Saxon name for one who wields a weapon, a protector or defender. The name Sax carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sax usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sax belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Defender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sax total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
